title: Finding Your Calling: Matching Skills With Jobs in the Mutual Fund Industry
authors: Gjergji Cici; Mario Hendriock; Alexander Kempf
near_miss_reason: Time-varying controls (styles tried, industry tenure, log fund age, log fund size, expense ratio, turnover, flow, log fund-company size) in every main-text column (Tables II-XII, 46 reghdfe calls in table_code.do), and every column also absorbs additional additive fixed effects dominantstyle x year, where dominantstyle is the manager's dominant style in each year (time-varying, per readme_xlsx) rather than a fixed characteristic; the 'Time by Fund Company FE' columns have no manager (unit) FE at all. Staggered binary design: Match = 1 from the year a manager returns to a previously tried style, at manager-specific dates (switches off when the manager leaves the matched style). Data not shipped (CRSP, Morningstar).
eligible_reason: No column satisfies every design rule: all include time-varying fund/manager controls and a style x year FE on a time-varying style; half the columns replace the unit FE with fund-company x year FE. Table III event study (pre3 pre2 pre1 post1 post2 post3+) has the same controls and FE. Several tables use propensity-score-matched control sets (a sample restriction under 5b) but keep the controls. Data are licensed and not shipped.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe). Manager-year panel (fund-year in Table IV). Two FE sets per table: absorb(dominantstyle#date mngr_id#fundcompanyid) and absorb(dominantstyle#date date#fundcompanyid); Table IV absorb(style#date wficn). Clustered by manager and year (fund and year in Table IV).

screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF; OpenAlex abstract empty). Staggered match-discovery design, but controls and a time-varying style x year FE in every column; data not shipped. If the team treats time-varying style x year FE as categorical controls, the manager x fund-company columns would become 5c controls-only near-misses; moot without data.
hand_check_nov4: Not controls-only confirmed: besides the controls, every column absorbs a style-by-year FE on a time-varying style (an additional additive FE, which 5c keeps excluded) and half the columns lack unit FE. Flag false kept; reason text now names the additional fixed effects so the classifier no longer reads a single violation. Package only (no article text).
